cafes.name: The Moonlit Bean
cafes.reason: Rumoured to have the best cinnamon latte in town, plus a cat named Biscuit.

visits.author: Owner
visits.experience: Warm and a little cramped, in the best way. The croissant was gone in four minutes.
visits.conversation: We spent two hours on our dream road trip and ended up planning a route that touches nine different bakeries. We also argued about whether cereal is soup (it is not).
visits.funny: Biscuit the cat sat on the menu and refused to move. We ordered by pointing around her.
visits.notes: Come before 3pm for the window seats.

links.title: Biscuit vs. the menu
links.description: Our proof that the cat runs the place.

visits.author: Friend
visits.experience: Rainy afternoon, perfect for a long chat.
visits.conversation: We talked about new year goals and made a shared list of 5 small adventures. Also rehearsed our terrible karaoke duet.
visits.funny: The barista asked if we were a band. We said yes.

links.title: Rainy cafe playlist
links.description: The soundtrack we hummed all day.

cafes.name: Fern & Flour
cafes.reason: A plant-filled bakery with sourdough cinnamon rolls the size of a face.

cafes.name: Paper Crane Coffee
cafes.reason: Japanese-style hand-drip and a wall of origami.

visits.author: Owner
visits.experience: Quiet, tidy, a bit fancy. We whispered the whole time.
visits.conversation: Long talk about learning new hobbies. We each folded a crane and compared. Mine looked like a duck.
visits.funny: Our crane race across the table ended in a coffee spill.
visits.notes: Ask for the origami kit at the counter.
